GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An Overview of this role

We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team. This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls.

The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications. You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle. Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification.
  • Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability.
  • Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation.
  • Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora, and other Business Systems.
  • Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing.
  • Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases.
  • Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards.
  • Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting.
  • Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.
  • Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.
  • Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can adopt consistent delivery practices.
  • Coach engineers and application teams on GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD tools, release automation, trunk/branching strategies, testing, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with security, compliance, architecture, and enterprise application stakeholders to meet control requirements without creating unnecessary delivery friction.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in release engineering, DevOps or a related discipline.
  • Experience in Release & deployments for enterprise SaaS applications such as Salesforce, Zuora or Business Systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines in production environments.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation and integrations.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude or comparable enterprise-approved tools as part of day-to-day DevOps and release engineering work.
  • Experience with source control, branching and merging strategies, artifact management, automated testing, deployment orchestration, and rollback practices.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication patterns, and integration troubleshooting.
  • Experience managing releases across multiple environments with strong attention to configuration, dependencies, access controls, and auditability.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, integration defects, and environment inconsistencies.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, business, security, compliance, and operations teams.
  • Enterprise application releases become more predictable, repeatable, and transparent.
  • Manual deployment effort and avoidable release errors decrease through automation and standardization.

About the team

ETA teams adopt reusable GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD patterns for Salesforce, Zuora, and other enterprise platforms.Release quality improves through automated validation, testing, policy checks, and post-deployment verification. Deployment, change, and compliance evidence is available through reliable pipeline records and operational reporting. Application teams can move faster while maintaining appropriate controls for business-critical systems. AI-assisted DevOps adoption measurably improves engineering throughput, troubleshooting speed, automation coverage, and documentation quality without reducing delivery controls.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Job Summary: 

We are seeking a visionary Principal Product Solutions Architect to lead the technical design, configuration patterns, and system orchestration for our next-generation Enterprise Financial Close, Reconciliation, and Anomaly Detection product.Our product is built on top of an advanced, internal, metadata-driven low-code platform featuring a highly interactive, spreadsheet like user interface. This is a specialized product application and data modeling architecture role. Your core mandate is to translate intricate financial compliance logic into a scalable, high-performance product application layer, utilizing an internal engine that abstracts out transformations to natively run on Datalakes. You will architect the application patterns that enable a fast-moving engineering organization of a large team of developers to build concurrently while scaling to process hundreds of millions of transaction rows for global Fortune 500 enterprises.

Not Required: Infrastructure, CI/CD, DevOps, security/authentication, raw ERP data ingestion pipelines, and the standalone machine learning engines are completely managed by dedicated horizontal engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Metadata-Driven Application Design: Architect the semantic data layer, defining how standard and complex custom objects interact within an enterprise-wide low-code data catalog. Ensure flexible configurations seamlessly support varied multinational financial structures out of the box.

  • Performance Engineering: Own the approaches to best column-level transformation formulas. Ensure that complex data reconciliation mappings defined by users in an abstract UI adhere to highly efficient, parallelized, and cost-effective Snowflake SQL paths that avoid performance degradation or runaway cloud compute expenses during the critical month-end close window.

  • Cross-Team Technical Orchestration: Act as the primary technical ambassador and contract negotiator for the product unit. Collaborate directly with adjacent engineering teams to define robust, production-grade API contracts for ERP Data Ingestion, UI Widgets, and the AI/Rules anomaly detection engine.

  • Configuration Governance at Scale: Establish software development lifecycle (SDLC) best practices tailored for a low-code metadata environment. Define patterns for version control, component modularity, testing, and dependency management to enable a large engineering organization to build simultaneously without conflict or regressions.

  • Technical Domain Liaison: Work closely with a team of Product Managers to dissect sophisticated accounting workflows (such as intercompany reconciliations and ledger-to-subledger matching) and translate them into robust, reproducible platform configurations.

Skills and experience needed

  • Platform-Native Architectural Experience: A proven track record of designing large-scale, metadata-driven systems. Deep familiarity with expanding or building heavy business applications on top of highly structured platforms (e.g., Salesforce Lightning/Apex, ServiceNow, Guidewire, SAP NetWeaver, or highly complex internal PaaS frameworks).

  • Expertise in Domain-Driven Design (DDD): Superior capability to transform fluid business logic and accounting rules into immutable, structured entity relationships and declarative constraints.

  • Systems Orchestration Mindset: Exceptional capacity to design complex application state workflows, cross-system dependency mappings, and cleanly isolated service contracts without managing raw infrastructure.

  • Outstanding Technical Communication: A proven history of writing clear, comprehensive RFCs and technical documentation, with the executive presence to negotiate architectural priorities across multi-functional core platform teams. 

  • Prior experience working in the financial technology space (Corporate Accounting, Auditing, Fintech SaaS, or ERP customizations).

  • Experience designing software that complies with strict enterprise audit requirements (SOX compliance, data lineage, SOC 2).

What You Will NOT Need to Do

Because we have dedicated underlying infrastructure and core engine teams, your background does not need to emphasize:

  • Core cloud-native infrastructure administration (Kubernetes, Docker, Service Meshes, Terraform).

  • Low-level systems programming or building Java/Go microservices from scratch.

  • Writing raw Machine Learning training loops or building native ETL ingestion adapters.

Overview

At FRND, we’re building products that shape how millions of people connect, interact, and build meaningful relationships online.

We are looking for a Strategy Analyst who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, breaking down complex business challenges, and turning insights into action. This role sits at the intersection of business, product, growth, and strategy, working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities and drive high-impact initiatives.

What You'll Do

• Work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams on key strategic and business initiatives.
• Analyse business performance, user behaviour, market trends, and competitive landscapes to identify opportunities and risks.
• Break down complex and ambiguous business problems into structured analyses and actionable recommendations.
• Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and deep dives into new products, markets, and growth opportunities.
• Support strategic planning and help identify initiatives that can drive growth, profitability, and long-term business value.
• Work with product, growth, marketing, and operations teams to evaluate business performance and improve decision-making.
• Build business cases, frameworks, and presentations to communicate recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
• Track key initiatives and help ensure strategic priorities translate into execution.
• Take ownership of high-impact problem statements from identifying the problem to driving the solution.
• Use data and structured thinking to challenge assumptions and influence important business decisions.

What We're Looking For

• 1–3 years of experience in strategy, business analytics, consulting, business operations, investment banking, startups, or other problem-solving-intensive roles.
• Strong academic background from a Tier 1 institution, preferably IITs, BITS, NITs, or equivalent institutions.
• Exceptional analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work with data and derive meaningful insights; SQL proficiency is preferred.
• Strong understanding of business fundamentals, growth, and market dynamics.
• Comfortable working with ambiguous problem statements where the path to the answer isn't always clear.
• Ability to communicate complex ideas simply through presentations, documents, and discussions.
• Strong ownership and willingness to go beyond the obvious answer.
• Someone who is curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out independently.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth, and dynamic environment.

Note: The FRND team works 6 days a week, with the 1st and 3rd Saturdays being working days.

About FRND

FRND is redefining the way people connect by building social products that are engaging, safe, inclusive, and fun.

We’re a rapidly growing startup building for millions of users and solving unique challenges across social connection and entertainment. Our ambition is bold, and we're looking for people who want to build, experiment, and solve problems at scale.

Why FRND?

🌍 Impact at Scale: Work on products and initiatives that impact millions of users across India and international markets.
🚀 High Ownership: Take on meaningful problems and have the freedom to drive them from idea to execution.
🧠 Learn with the Best: Work closely with founders, leaders, and high-performing teams while solving real business challenges.
💼 Rewarding Journey: Competitive compensation, equity opportunities, and growth that matches your impact.
🎉 Work Hard, Have Fun: We're serious about building great products, but we also believe in enjoying the journey along the way.
💡 Solve Interesting Problems: Work in an environment where curiosity, experimentation, and first-principles thinking are encouraged.
